description: Making AI Work: As part of the initiative, the Higher Education Department has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Edunet Foundation to implement the AI Careers for Women (AICW) programme across higher education institutions in the state.
body_lead: Odisha launches AI skills initiative to build future-ready women workforce As part of the initiative, the Higher Education Department has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Edunet Foundation to implement the AI Careers for Women (AICW) programme across higher education institutions in the state. The Odisha government has launched an initiative to equip female students with advanced skills in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies.
